title: Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING Sequel Anime Announced
content:
A new Dr. STONE sequel anime titled Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING is officially in production. The project will continue the story after the conclusion of the TV anime , which premiered its series finale on June 25, 2026.

The new anime will adapt “TERRAFORMING,” a sequel story included in Volume 27 of the original manga. An announcement trailer featuring newly recorded dialogue from Senku was also released.

The manga’s author Riichiro Inagaki shared a comment:

“Thank you to everyone watching STONE FES. 2026! The Dr. STONE anime actually made it all the way to the final chapter of the original manga. I was deeply moved. And yet, somehow! There’s still more…!! It wasn’t a lie! After all, Senku and the others’ scientific adventure was still continuing. Actually, that kind of lie is more than welcome! You can even say this finale event being the finale was a lie too! So everyone, please watch over Senku and the others’ science for just a little while longer. This is insanely exhilarating!!”

Manga artist Boichi also commented:

“To everyone attending STONE FES. 2026, everyone watching the stream, and everyone who has watched the Dr. STONE anime, thank you so much as always! I’m truly happy that we can share the joy of the news that the Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING anime is being produced. Please look forward to further updates!”

TV anime character designer Yuko Iwasa also drew a commemorative illustration for the announcement:

Riichiro Inagaki wrote the Dr. STONE manga, with art by Boichi. The series ended after 5 years of serialization on March 7, 2022 with a total of 232 chapters. The creators shared a special illustration and messages:

The Dr. STONE a nime adaptation began airing in July 2019, with its first season running for 24 episodes. It was followed by Dr. STONE: STONE WARS in January 2021, an 11-episode second season focused on the conflict between the Kingdom of Science and Tsukasa’s Empire of Might. The series then received the Dr. STONE: Ryusui special in July 2022, which introduced Ryusui Nanami.

The third season, Dr. STONE: NEW WORLD , aired across two split cours in 2023 and covered the Treasure Island arc . Immediately after its finale, the fourth and final season, Dr. STONE: SCIENCE FUTURE , was announced. The final season aired over three split cours from 2025 to 2026, concluding the anime adaptation on June 25, 2026 and bringing Senku’s story, the mystery of petrification, and the Kingdom of Science’s journey to their end.

The adaptation has a total of four seasons and one special: 24 episodes in Season 1, 11 in Season 2, the Ryusui special, 22 in Season 3, and 37 in Season 4, coming up to 94 regular TV episodes plus one special, or 95 animated episodes total.

title: 'I am the only one who is not attacked in the world filled with zombies' TV Anime's Main Promo Video Previews Theme Songs
content:
The official website for the television anime of Rokuro Uraji 's I am the only one who is not attacked in the world filled with zombies . ( Zombie no Afureta Sekai de Ore Dake ga Osowarenai ) novel series revealed the show's main promotional video, key visual, additional cast, and theme song information on Saturday.

RetBear performs the opening theme song "No Reaction," and Itsuka▶ (Itsuka Saisei) performs the ending theme song "Tsukikage" (Moonlight). The above video previews both songs.

The new cast members include:

Rikako Ito as Tokiko Kurose

Marie Miyake as Sayaka Makiura

The anime will debut in January 2027 and will air on the premium AT-X channel.

The series will star Wataru Katō as Yūsuke Takemura and Yuno Azuma as Mitsuki Fujino.

Kazuya Fujishiro ( Dropkick on My Devil! , Girlfriend, Girlfriend , Cells at Work! Code Black episode director) is directing the anime at acca effe and Frontier Engine . Yasushi Hirano ( City Hunter , The Brave Fighter of Legend Da-Garn ) is in charge of the series scripts, Kayo Shimoyama and Makuto Okimiru are writing the scripts, and Megumi Ishihara ( Fate/stay night , Fortune Arterial: Akai Yakusoku ) is designing the characters. Tadashi Jinbo (2026 High School! Kimengumi , Uma Yuru ) is the sound director at Bisei , and ISAO is composing the music at Frontier Works .

The anime was previously announced to debut this year.

The "zombie panic action" story takes place in a world that is suddenly flooded with zombies, and for some reason the protagonist Takemura is the only person the zombies do not attack. If this were a zombie movie, Takemura would use this ability to fight against the zombies, but instead he just acts according to his desires.

Uraji launched the story on the R18 version of the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in January 2013 and ended the story in 2017. Frontier Works published three volumes for the series with illustrations by Saburō in 2016 to 2017.

Chihiro Masuda launched a manga adaptation in June 2021, and Frontier Works released the fifth manga volume on August 5. Robo Kondō launched a spinoff manga titled Zombie no Afureta Sekai de Ore Dake ga Osowarenai Tokiko IF STORY on the Comic CMOA website in October 2025. The spinoff manga's first volume also shipped on August 5.

title: 'Zombie no Afureta Sekai de Ore dake ga Osowarenai' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, First Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Rokuro Uraji 's Zombie no Afureta Sekai de Ore dake ga Osowarenai ( In a World Full of Zombies I'm the Only One Who Doesn't Get Attacked ) light novel unveiled additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and first promotional video on Saturday. The anime series will premiere on AT-X in January 2027.

Voice actresses Rikako Itou ( Mushoku no Eiyuu ) and Marie Miyake ( Gin no Saji ) are joining the casts as Tokiko Kurose and Sayaka Makiura, respectively.

Staff Art Design: Ami Takasusuki ( Saikyou no Shienshoku "Wajutsushi" de Aru Ore wa Sekai Saikyou Clan wo Shitagaeru ), You Shinomiya , Recommendation Art Director: Shinji Katahira ( Nakanohito Genome [Jikkyouchuu] ), Shinobu Takahashi ( "Kimi wo Aisuru Ki wa Nai" to Itta Jiki Koushaku-sama ga Nazeka Dekiai shitekimasu ) Color Design: Shinobu Hirayama Director of Photography: Yuuki Sakurai (Rare Trick) Editing: Kouki Shinkai ( Peter Grill to Kenja no Jikan )

Music group RetBear ( Kuro no Shoukanshi ) is performing the opening theme "No Reaction." Japanese idol group Itsuka▶ is performing the ending theme "Tsukikage." Both theme songs are previewed in the first promotional video below.

Kazuya Fujishiro ( Haishin Yuusha ) is directing the anime at Acca effe and Frontier Engine , with Yasushi Hirano ( City Hunter ) handling the series composition, assisted by Kayou Shimoyama . Shimoyama and Rumakuto Okimi are penning the script. Yoshiharu Ishihara ( Fortune Arterial ) is designing the characters, and ISAO ( bloodivores ) is composing the music.

Rokuro began penning the supernatural horror novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in January 2013. Frontier Works later acquired the series and began publishing the title under its Nox Novels label in February 2016, featuring illustrations by Saburou . The third volume went on sale in March 2017.

Chihiro Matsuda began drawing a manga adaptation on the Comic Ragchew web service in March 2022. NTT Solmare began publishing the manga adaptation on its MangaPlaza web service and app in September 2024, followed by the release of the fifth volume on August 5.

Robo Kondo launched a spin-off manga on the same website in October 2025. The first volume went on sale on August 5.

title: Billy Bat Manga Wins Harvey Award
content:
The Harvey Awards, which honor outstanding work in comics and sequential art, announced the winners for this year's awards on Friday at New York Comic Con . Naoki Urasawa and Takashi Nagasaki 's Billy Bat manga, released by Abrams ComicArts ' Kana imprint, won the award for Best Manga. Kristi Iwashiro translates the manga.

The other nominees in the category included:

• He Rolled Me Up Like a Grilled Squid by Yoshiharu Tsuge (Drawn & Quarterly, translated by Ryan Holmberg)

• Land by Kazumi Yamashita (Yen Press, translated by Kevin Gifford)

• Miss Ruki by Fumiko Takano (New York Review Comics, translated by Alexa Frank)

• My Gorilla Family by Ichiro Iijima (Living the Line, translated by Ryan Holmberg)

• My Life in 24 Frames per Second by Rintarō (Kana/Abrams ComicArts, translated by Montana Kane)

Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc , Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle - Akaza Sairai , My Hero Academia — Final Season , the One Piece: Into the Grand Line live-action season, and the Korean animated film Your Letter were nominated for Best Adaptation from Comic Book/Graphic Novel category. However, Spider-Noir won the award.

Kamome Shirahama 's Witch Hat Atelier won the Best Manga award last year.

The Harvey Awards added the Best Manga category in 2018. Kabi Nagata 's My Lesbian Experience with Loneliness manga won the first award in this category. Kōhei Horikoshi 's My Hero Academia won the award in 2019, and Kamome Shirahama 's Witch Hat Atelier won the award in 2020. Tatsuki Fujimoto 's Chainsaw Man won the award in 2021, 2022, and 2023. Ryōko Kui 's Delicious in Dungeon won the award in 2024.

In previous years, manga were nominated alongside other comics in the "Best American Edition of Foreign Material" category. The last manga to win the category was Hajime Isayama 's Attack on Titan in 2014. One-Punch Man and Showa: A History of Japan (1953-1989) were nominated in 2016 but did not win. "Best American Edition of Foreign Material" is no longer a category.

Unlike the Eisner Awards and other awards in the North American comic book industry, the Harvey Awards are nominated and selected by the comic book professionals themselves.

title: 10 Best Anime to Binge on Crunchyroll in October 2026
content:
The final quarter of the year has already begun, and there’s no surprise that Crunchyroll is bringing all the major series to its library. As the largest streaming platform for anime fans across the world, Crunchyroll offers an exciting range of series across all genres. The Fall 2026 anime season brings a new lineup of exciting shows on the platform. There’s no denying that the sequel seasons of The Apothecary Diaries and Black Clover grabbed all the spotlight this quarter. However, since this season’s anime were released only this month, there aren’t enough episodes for fans to binge.

New series within the seasonal lineup broadcast weekly episodes in Japan, after which Crunchyroll adds them to its library for fans across the globe. Not to mention that keeping up with weekly episodes isn’t ideal for those who prefer binge-watching, especially during the weekends when someone just needs a break after a long week. It’s also overwhelming to keep up with the updates since most episodes tend to end on a cliffhanger and make fans wait for several days before revealing what happens next. If you’re looking to watch new anime shows this month that have already released full seasons, then this list is perfect for you.

10) Saga of Tanya the Evil

This exciting isekai wrapped up its second season not too long ago, after making fans wait years for a sequel. Based on the 2013 action fantasy light novel of the same name, the anime premiered in 2017. When it comes to the isekai genre, Saga of Tanya the Evil stands out for some of the most unique themes and an exciting premise. The story is famous for its WWI-style world, combined with realistic military strategy and intense action, following a reincarnated protagonist who is completely unfamiliar with the world. The anime aired 12 episodes in the first season before returning with a sequel film in February 2019. After more than six years of waiting, the anime finally returned with a second season to continue the journey of Tanya Degurechaff. While there hasn’t been any confirmation on the anime’s continuation, considering that the light novel is ongoing, we might get another season in the next few years.

9) Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia

One of the anime that stood out the most during this year’s Summer lineup was Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia . Produced by Science SARU, the same studio as Dandadan, the anime stood out for its stunning visuals. Surprisingly enough, it turned out to be one of the darkest anime on Crunchyroll this year, which is all the more reason it captured viewers’ attention. The story follows a young girl named Sitara who lost everything in life after the Tus Militia falls at the hands of the Nomads. Unfortunately, the anime’s first season reached its conclusion on September 12th, 2026, and it has yet to confirm a second season as of now. While the anime’s first season ends on a fairly satisfying note, it has to adapt a huge chunk of the story from the manga. Sitara’s journey is only at the initial stage, and it will be full of trials and tribulations in the future.`

8) Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You

After an unconventional premiere, this romance drama surprisingly became one of the biggest hits of the year. The anime had an early premiere in June this year with mini-episodes that feature parts of the first six episodes. Thanks to the unique strategy of releasing 12 mini-episodes a month before the original premiere in July, the anime grabbed all the attention when the Spring 2026 anime series were already reaching their end. The anime is based on the acclaimed manga written and illustrated by Jinushi, which was published as a webcomic on X in March 2022 (known as Twitter at the time). Not long after, it began serialization in Square Enix’s Monthly Big Gangan magazine in July 2022 and grabbed enough attention to get an anime adaptation. While the first season has already reached its conclusion, fans are still awaiting updates on a sequel as there’s still a majority of the story left to adapt.

7) Black Torch

Another series that grabbed all the spotlight during this year’s summer season is Black Torch. Eight years after the manga cancellation, the series became a fan-favorite thanks to the anime debut this summer season. Written and illustrated by Tsuyoshi Takaki, the manga was serialized in Shueisha’s Jump Square magazine from 2016 to 2018 on a monthly schedule. The story centers around a 17-year-old Jiro Azuma, who was born with the ability to talk with animals since he is the descendant of a long-standing shinobi clan . However, his life takes an unexpected turn when he saves an injured cat, only to learn that it’s a demonic spirit known as a mononoke. However, the true potential of the story didn’t go unnoticed by Studio EEK, which is why an anime adaptation was confirmed several years later. Since the manga didn’t have a lot of chapters, it adapts the entire story in 12 episodes with minor expanded moments and extended action sequences, which makes it a perfect binge-worthy series for the weekend.

6) Though I Am an Inept Villainess

This fantasy drama grabbed all the attention for sharing a similar setting and vibe as The Apothecary Diaries. Produced by Doga Kobo, the same animation studio behind Oshi no Ko , Though I Am an Inept Villainess became one of the biggest hits of the year. The first season is split into two cours, and the second one will return in January next year as part of the Winter 2027 lineup. The story begins with Keigetsu’s jealousy towards Reirin, forcing her to plan an evil scheme and successfully swap bodies. However, since then the story has focused on their growing relationship as they form a sort of partnership after they put their initial differences behind them. Things will take a huge turn in the second part of the first season as Reirin and Keigetsu continue to struggle in the Inner Palace after their bodies have been switched. The first cour wrapped up in Episode 11 before pointing toward the upcoming Harvest Festival in the southern lands.

5) The Apothecary Diaries

Since the anime is currently airing its third season, it’s the perfect time for you to rewatch the previous two seasons while waiting for more episodes. When it comes to historical dramas, there’s no denying that The Apothecary Diaries is by far the most popular one in recent years. Based on the critically acclaimed light novel by Natsu Hyuga, the story centers around Maomao, a genius apothecary with a knack for solving all kinds of mysteries. Set in a Chinese-style imperial palace, this mystery drama immediately became a fan-favorite after its debut in 2023. Since then, its popularity only keeps increasing, which is all the more reason it’s getting a feature-length movie and even a live-action. Season 3 is turning out to be the most exciting part of the story as it follows the changes that took place after the Shi Clan’s rebellion failed terribly. The latest season will be split into two cours, but the second one will premiere in Spring 2027.

4) Black Clover

Black Clover returned with a sequel five years after the original anime ended on a massive cliffhanger. The manga has already reached its conclusion, while the anime premiered its second season as part of the Fall 2026 lineup. The anime will continue the Spade Kingdom Raid Arc, the best arc in the series, where the Magic Knights and mages from the Heart Kingdom fight against the Dark Triad. Since the latest season has only just been released, there’s no better time for fans to binge the previous episodes, especially since catching up might take longer than usual. The original anime was released as a long-running series, airing more than 160 episodes in only a few years. This is also the major reason why the anime’s return took longer than usual since it had already caught up with the manga. Now that the manga is already over, the anime will be running on a seasonal schedule to adapt this incredible story by Yuki Tabata.

3) Mashle: Magic and Muscles

2) Daemons of the Shadow Realm

1) Wistoria: Wand and Sword

Do you agree with our picks – or have an anime in mind that you want to add here? Share your recommendations in the comments below.

Thanks to the unique strategy of releasing 12 mini-episodes a month before the original premiere in July, the anime grabbed all the attention when the Spring 2026 anime series were already reaching their end. The anime is based on the acclaimed manga written and illustrated by Jinushi, which was published as a webcomic on X in March 2022 (known as Twitter at the time). Not long after, it began serialization in Square Enix’s Monthly Big Gangan magazine in July 2022 and grabbed enough attention to get an anime adaptation. While the first season has already reached its conclusion, fans are still awaiting updates on a sequel as there’s still a majority of the story left to adapt.
7) Black Torch

Another series that grabbed all the spotlight during this year’s summer season is Black Torch. Eight years after the manga cancellation, the series became a fan-favorite thanks to the anime debut this summer season. Written and illustrated by Tsuyoshi Takaki, the manga was serialized in Shueisha’s Jump Square magazine from 2016 to 2018 on a monthly schedule. The story centers around a 17-year-old Jiro Azuma, who was born with the ability to talk with animals since he is the descendant of a long-standing shinobi clan . However, his life takes an unexpected turn when he saves an injured cat, only to learn that it’s a demonic spirit known as a mononoke. However, the true potential of the story didn’t go unnoticed by Studio EEK, which is why an anime adaptation was confirmed several years later. Since the manga didn’t have a lot of chapters, it adapts the entire story in 12 episodes with minor expanded moments and extended action sequences, which makes it a perfect binge-worthy series for the weekend.
6) Though I Am an Inept Villainess

This fantasy drama grabbed all the attention for sharing a similar setting and vibe as The Apothecary Diaries. Produced by Doga Kobo, the same animation studio behind Oshi no Ko , Though I Am an Inept Villainess became one of the biggest hits of the year. The first season is split into two cours, and the second one will return in January next year as part of the Winter 2027 lineup. The story begins with Keigetsu’s jealousy towards Reirin, forcing her to plan an evil scheme and successfully swap bodies. However, since then the story has focused on their growing relationship as they form a sort of partnership after they put their initial differences behind them. Things will take a huge turn in the second part of the first season as Reirin and Keigetsu continue to struggle in the Inner Palace after their bodies have been switched. The first cour wrapped up in Episode 11 before pointing toward the upcoming Harvest Festival in the southern lands.
5) The Apothecary Diaries

Since the anime is currently airing its third season, it’s the perfect time for you to rewatch the previous two seasons while waiting for more episodes. When it comes to historical dramas, there’s no denying that The Apothecary Diaries is by far the most popular one in recent years. Based on the critically acclaimed light novel by Natsu Hyuga, the story centers around Maomao, a genius apothecary with a knack for solving all kinds of mysteries. Set in a Chinese-style imperial palace, this mystery drama immediately became a fan-favorite after its debut in 2023. Since then, its popularity only keeps increasing, which is all the more reason it’s getting a feature-length movie and even a live-action. Season 3 is turning out to be the most exciting part of the story as it follows the changes that took place after the Shi Clan’s rebellion failed terribly. The latest season will be split into two cours, but the second one will premiere in Spring 2027.
4) Black Clover

Black Clover returned with a sequel five years after the original anime ended on a massive cliffhanger. The manga has already reached its conclusion, while the anime premiered its second season as part of the Fall 2026 lineup. The anime will continue the Spade Kingdom Raid Arc, the best arc in the series, where the Magic Knights and mages from the Heart Kingdom fight against the Dark Triad. Since the latest season has only just been released, there’s no better time for fans to binge the previous episodes, especially since catching up might take longer than usual. The original anime was released as a long-running series, airing more than 160 episodes in only a few years. This is also the major reason why the anime’s return took longer than usual since it had already caught up with the manga. Now that the manga is already over, the anime will be running on a seasonal schedule to adapt this incredible story by Yuki Tabata.
3) Mashle: Magic and Muscles
2) Daemons of the Shadow Realm
1) Wistoria: Wand and Sword
Do you agree with our picks – or have an anime in mind that you want to add here? Share your recommendations in the comments below.

title: 4 Years Later, Beloved Shonen Jump Series Finally Has an Exciting Update for Fans
content:
Shueisha is a major publishing company with almost a dozen manga magazines under its belt. While the publisher focuses on all the major demographics, there’s no denying that nothing can match the popularity of the Shonen series. Unlike the famous Weekly Shonen Jump magazine, which was launched in 1968, Jump SQ. by the same publisher doesn’t have a long history since it’s only a little more than a decade old. However, it has introduced readers to some of the most incredible manga of all time. Some of the fan-favorite series include Claymore , Blue Exorcist , Moriarty the Patriot , and many more, which have already received their anime adaptations.

However, a few incredible series are still awaiting their anime debut, including Yuto Sano’s dark fantasy, Gokurakugai . The series debuted in 2022 as a continuation of Sano’s one-shot manga, which was released in 2020. It’s the creator’s first serialized manga, and it immediately captured readers’ hearts thanks to its captivating art, lovable characters, and intriguing premise. While the manga’s updates are slow due to its monthly schedule and many hiatuses, its popularity only keeps increasing thanks to the exceptional story. The series will take the stage during one of the largest events of the year, which is all the more reason to believe fans can expect an anime confirmation soon.

Gokurakugai Is Taking the Stage During Jump Festa 2027

It’s already that time of the year when fans are getting updates on Jump Festa , the largest anime and manga convention held by Shueisha. Jump Festa is held annually during the month of December, where tens of thousands of visitors attend the two-day event to experience exclusive events, including new announcements for anime, manga, and games, interactive exhibits, and unique merchandise that is often available only at the convention. As the name suggests, Jump Festa focuses on Shueisha’s Shonen Jump magazines such as Weekly Shonen Jump , Jump Square , V Jump , Saikyo Jump , and the online platform Shonen Jump+ .

The event this year will be held on December 19th and 20th. A few days ago, the list of all the series holding a panel during the two-day convention was revealed, and it also includes Gokurakugai on the Jump Station Stage. This is the same stage where Black Clover and many more beloved series will also be grabbing the spotlight. While the date and timing for the panel haven’t been revealed yet, we can at least expect a major announcement regarding the series . It might be possible that the wait for the anime confirmation is finally over.

Although the manga was released four years ago, it still hasn’t released even 40 chapters due to the hiatuses. Around a year after its debut, Manga Plus added the series to its library, and it has kept up with the updates ever since. While the number of chapters is significantly less based on the time since it began serialization, there’s no doubt it has more than enough material to adapt a 12-13 episode long season. Not only that, but with over 1.4 million copies in circulation, the series has more than enough of a wide fanbase to ensure that the anime will be a huge success as long as it’s adapted well.

Gokurakugai Is One of the Most Beloved Dark Fantasies in Recent Years

With this year’s Jump Festa potentially bringing an exciting update on Gokurakugai , fans may finally have something to look forward to after years of waiting. The series always stood out for its unique designs and stunning visuals. However, the story has also been taking shape in the past few chapters as the truth about the protagonist’s origins and the villain’s goals comes to light. This story is set in Gokurakuga i, which translates to Paradise District, a vibrant area hiding a dark secret in the shadows.

It centers around Tao and Alma, two troubleshooters for hire, working in the Saragi Anti-Maga Organization. Their primary job is to solve various cases, which revolve around finding missing people or dealing with gang-related issues, especially those missions that revolve around mysterious evil creatures known as Magas. These dangerous creatures come from dead humans and animals, possessing unimaginable strength and terrorizing the innocent citizens of Gokurakugai .

Tao is skilled at handling any threat that comes her way after her troubled past led her to take on such a dangerous job. On the other hand, Alma is a teenage boy with a kind heart who always needs to keep his mysterious powers in check. The story focuses on his identity and embraces his humanity as the truth behind his origin comes to light. While there’s no confirmation regarding the anime announcement, fans do have hope this time around since Jump Festa is the only stage where the series will confirm its highly anticipated adaptation.

Do you think this beloved dark fantasy will finally get an anime adaptation announcement, and what are your expectations for the series? Let us know in the comments below.

title: My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute To Live With! Releases Teaser PV and Cast News
content:
The Deregula YouTube Channel has revealed a promo video for My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! The PV featured information on some of the anime’s cast and staff. Doukyo Shiteiru Kensei o Onna Shinshou ga Kawisugite Mainichi Shiawase Desu will premiere in January. Studio Wolfsbane and Lightbox are animating the adaptation.

The anime’s voice cast includes

• Ai Kakuma as Liza Parsandra

• Seena Hoshiki as Eugene Dawson

• Azusa Tsujimori as Erin Toa

• Hitomi Ueda as Cordelia Dawson

• Miyu Tomita as Fiona Rosso

• Minami Takahashi as Lumiere Theomere

• Tomoyo Takayanagi as Meris Eclipse

• Hitomi Ueda as the Narrator

Masayoshi Nishida, known for his directorial work on Makina-san’s a Love Bot! will direct My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! Additional staff includes

• Noriyoshi Sasaki — Technical Director

• Ichirou Tanaka — Character Design

• Ayame Eto —Sub Character Design

• Youhei Kashii — Scripts

• Yusho Hayakawa — Chief Animation Director & Sub Character Design

• 12Sound — Music

You can view the PV below.

My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! tells the story of Eugene Dawson, who, in his quest to become stronger, becomes an apprentice to the Sword Saint Liza. Although Liza’s skills are feared on the battlefield, she’s a total klutz in everyday life. Can Eugene train properly when Liza’s clumsiness and accidental perviness keep distracting him?

Kennoji and illustrator R_ringo launched My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! in March 2024. Kadokawa’s KadoComi has serialized the manga since its debut. The publisher has since compiled the manga into two volumes. Seven Seas Entertainment releases the series in English through its Ghost Ship imprint.

title: This Solo Leveling Competitor Ended With No Season 2 Hopes, But It Really Needs More Episodes
content:
The Fall 2026 anime season has finally begun after concluding the Summer series. While the ongoing season is airing the sequels of The Apothecary Diaries and Black Clover, the previous season was famous for unique debuts. Tomb Raider King is one of the most hyped shows on Crunchyroll, which concluded its first season before the Fall 2026 season began. While the anticipated Solo Leveling movie is still a while away , fans were able to fill the void this Summer 2026 season with the debut of Tomb Raider King . The anime grabbed attention for sharing striking similarities with the popular manhwa adaptation even before its premiere.

Solo Leveling isn’t the first manhwa adaptation, but there’s no denying that the anime industry has seen a boom in these stories ever since its popularity. Tomb Raider King is another one of those series that shared similar vibes to this massive hit . It was initially expected to conclude on September 24th, but it was hit with an unexpected delay due to broadcasting issues. However, while the series has already reached its finale, there haven’t been any updates on the second season yet. The anime is based on a popular webtoon of the same name, which has over 400 chapters. This means that the anime has only covered the initial phase of the story.

Tomb Raider King Deserves Another Chance With Season 2

After the initial hype died down, the anime didn’t manage to sustain its popularity. Instead of being considered a massive hit, the series is a sleeper underperformer with mixed reviews. However, since the story is much longer than Solo Leveling , it’s taking its time setting up the premise and introducing fans to the world-building. The story follows Jooheon as he embarks on a journey after traveling back in time so he can take revenge on those who betrayed him. Tomb Raider King primarily leans into a corporate treasure war, comedy, and stealing powerful artifacts from rivals using prior knowledge of the future. While the anime has barely scratched the surface of the story , things will get more intense for Jooheon in his path of revenge.

The season finale ended on a massive cliffhanger as Ryoga reveals himself as the main villain of the story who plans to collect all relics and dominate the world. The anime should have been renewed for a second season right after the finale broadcast, which is common for major shows. However, it’s also not unusual for anime shows to drop sequel confirmations after making fans wait for a few months or even more than a year. As of now, it can’t be certain if the anime will ever return with a sequel, especially after the poor reviews it received during the time of its broadcast. Even so, we can’t rule out the possibility that the studio might need some time before the official confirmation, considering the scale of the project.

Head down to the comments below to let us know if you are anticipating a second season of Tomb Raider King. Or you could tell us your favorite moment from the webtoon that you want to see in the anime.

title: How Not to Summon a Demon Lord Ult Releases Visual & Staff Details
content:
The production committee for How Not to Summon a Demon Lord ULT has released a teaser visual and details about the main staff. Tezuka Productions will return to animate the series. Studio Okuruto Noboru, which worked on the previous season, will not be involved.

Satoshi Kuwabara is also returning as director. His other directing credits include The Quintessential Quintuplets and The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses . Other returning staff members include series composer Kazuyuki Fudeyasu and character designer Shizue Kaneko.

Additional staff members for Isekai Maou to Shoukan Shoujo no Dorei Majutsu Ult include:

• Zenjiro Ukelele (previously season 2’s chief animation director) — Character Design

• Satoshi Motoyama — Sound Director

• Yuusuke Katou — Music

How Not to Summon a Demon Lord ULT ’s main VAs will reprise their roles.

• Masaaki Mizunaka as Diablo

• Azumi Waki as Rem

• Yu Serizawa as Shera

The production committee has not yet announced a premiere date for Season 3. Crunchyroll streams the first two seasons.

The series is based on How Not to Summon a Demon Lord, a light novel written by Yukiya Murasaki and illustrated by Takahiro Tsurusaki. Its story follows Takuma Sakamoto, a hikikomori NEET who spends his days playing the MMORPG Cross Reverie . Though he’s a top-ranked player, his life outside the game is less impressive.

One day, Takuma finds himself in a world that mimics Cross Reverie ! And to add to his confusion, he’s in the body of his Cross Reverie character, the Demon Lord Diablo! But what is he doing there? Well, a demi-human and an elf summoned Diable to make him their servant!

Unfortunately for them, Diablo’s magical ring reverses the spell, making them his servants instead. Now stuck in Cross Reverie , Diablo must survive his newfound world with his servants in tow.
